components.name: Alert
components.purpose: An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error.

components.name: AppsNotifications
components.purpose: A settings panel with one switch per app, to turn each app’s notifications on or off.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: An avatar represents a person or team with their photo, or their initials when there’s no photo.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: A button triggers an action in place: saving a form, opening a dialog, deleting an item.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container.

components.name: ChooseCard
components.purpose: Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.purpose: A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button.

components.name: InputField
components.purpose: An input field lets people enter a single line of text: a name, an email address, a search term.

components.name: MeetingCard
components.purpose: A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Pagination moves between pages of a long list or table.

components.name: ProductCard
components.purpose: A product card shows one product in a grid or list: photo, name, short description, rating and price, with an optional sale price and actions.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time.
